g.text: HPS active-sensor geometry and symmetric decay rays
2015: ≥5 paired stations each, positron L1+L2. 2016: ≥5 paired stations each. 2021: ≥10 e⁺ / ≥8 e⁻ strip hits.
Solid/dashed: projected aperture; grey dotted: nominal 15 mrad. Either charge assignment; horizontal seams omitted; no magnetic transport.
